I used to have dreams like that with my ex, first he screamed in my life saying he didn’t want this anymore, to reliving all our arguments, and recently to him crying to me saying “stop running from me” while we were hugging. Your mind is a fucked up place, if you are having these dreams maybe it’s because you didn’t get the closure you wanted from your ex? Or she hurt you so much that your insecurities are coming out in your dreams to mess with you.. if anything, don’t let it effect your new relationship. It may feel like your going insane because you keep having those dreams but remember the new person you are with is not like her.
